t: Why The Neutron Fraction Matters For Water

t: Why Availability Matters For The Grid
d: For firm service, being available at the moment of need is everything; a resource's grid value collapses if it is down when called.

t: Why The Burner Is Not A Sole Tier III Source

t: Why DEC Removes the Steam Cycle
d: The steam cycle is the reason thermal plants are large, hot, and thirsty; direct conversion lets the burner skip it entirely.
Every thermal power plant obeys the second law: it must dump waste heat to a cold reservoir, and evaporating water is the most effective way to do that cheaply.

t: Why Thermal Plants Need A Cold Sink
d: A heat engine produces work only by moving heat from hot to cold; without a cold sink to receive the rejected heat, the engine stops.
